humanInstruction:
P0-S1 — Multi-Assessment Foundation & Creation

Implement the multi-assessment foundation required for later SAMA CSF assessment readiness.

Product outcome: A Compliance Analyst can create a second named assessment, select the currently available framework option, define the assessment period, switch between assessments, reload without losing the active assessment, and preserve the existing seeded assessment separately.

Required behavior:
1. Support multiple Assessment records / assessment registry.
2. Persist an active assessment identity.
3. Provide a user-visible way to create a new assessment.
4. New assessment fields: unique assessment ID, name, frameworkId, startDate, targetEndDate.
5. Support switching between assessments.
6. Active assessment selection must survive normal reload using the existing local demo persistence model.
7. Assessment-scoped product surfaces must use the selected assessment and must not leak data from another assessment.
8. Preserve existing seeded assessment assess-001 semantically and behaviorally.
9. New P0-S1 assessments are assessment SHELLS with 0 controls, 0 evidence requests, 0 review items.
10. Empty assessment must explicitly communicate controls have not yet been instantiated.
11. Synthetic metric/control padding must NOT fabricate controls, evidence, progress, maturity, or operational work for empty assessments.
12. Until P0-S2, framework selector must identify the currently available SAMA CSF option honestly as a demo/sample framework — do not imply full SAMA CSF catalogue exists.
13. Reset Demo resets entire local demo state to canonical single seeded assess-001 state (not per-assessment delete).
14. DemoState schema-version change and canonical reset on schema mismatch are permitted where required.

Out of scope: complete SAMA CSF catalogue, control instantiation, prior-year linkage/guidance, Control Owner assignment UX, Evidence Owner reassignment UX, SLA changes, AI-review changes, production persistence/auth/multi-tenancy, unrelated Wave-2 UX.

Acceptance tests required:
A. Creating assessment produces unique independently addressable assessment ID.
B. name, frameworkId, startDate, targetEndDate persist after reload.
C. Creating/switching assessments does not alter seeded assess-001 entities or workflow state.
D. New assessment: 0 controls, 0 evidence requests, no review items.
E. No assess-001 data in new assessment dashboard, control lists, evidence queues, reviews, workspace surfaces.
F. No synthetic padding fabricating controls/progress for empty assessment.
G. Switching back to assess-001 restores seeded/demo experience.
H. Reset Demo removes user-created assessments, restores canonical assess-001 and active-assessment state.
I. Schema-version mismatch/reset behavior tested.
J. Existing regression tests remain green.
K. New multi-assessment/scoping tests added.

Verification gates: npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test, npm run build.

Browser verification: Create assessment → confirm truthful empty state → reload → confirm persistence → switch to assess-001 → confirm seeded experience → switch back → verify isolation → Reset Demo → confirm user-created assessment removed and canonical seed restored. Prove new assessment does not show synthetic controls/progress.
